mapper.select: SELECT c.Client_ID, c.username, c.email, c.cash_balance, c.password_hash, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.dob, c.street_address, c.city, c.state_name, c.zip_code, c.region, c.phone_number, c.ssn, c.ClientStatus_ID, cs.ClientStatus_Name FROM Clients c LEFT JOIN Client_Status cs ON c.ClientStatus_ID = cs.ClientStatus_ID WHERE c.Client_ID = #{id}

SELECT c.Client_ID, c.username, c.email, c.cash_balance, c.password_hash, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.dob, c.street_address, c.city, c.state_name, c.zip_code, c.region, c.phone_number, c.ssn, c.ClientStatus_ID, cs.ClientStatus_Name FROM Clients c LEFT JOIN Client_Status cs ON c.ClientStatus_ID = cs.ClientStatus_ID WHERE c.email = #{email}

SELECT c.Client_ID, c.username, c.email, c.cash_balance, c.password_hash, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.dob, c.street_address, c.city, c.state_name, c.zip_code, c.region, c.phone_number, c.ssn, c.ClientStatus_ID, cs.ClientStatus_Name FROM Clients c LEFT JOIN Client_Status cs ON c.ClientStatus_ID = cs.ClientStatus_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Clients (username, email, cash_balance, password_hash, first_name, last_name, dob, street_address, city, state_name, zip_code, region, phone_number, ssn, ClientStatus_ID) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{cashBalance}, #{passwordHash}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{dob}, #{streetAddress}, #{city}, #{stateName}, #{zipCode}, #{region}, #{phoneNumber}, #{ssn}, #{clientStatus.id})
mapper.update: UPDATE Clients SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, cash_balance = #{cashBalance}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, dob = #{dob}, street_address = #{streetAddress}, city = #{city}, state_name = #{stateName}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, region = #{region}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, ssn = #{ssn}, ClientStatus_ID = #{clientStatus.id} WHERE Client_ID = #{id}
